_doc: Challenges (GDD 9). Each counts 'event' entries emitted by the sim (shared/sim.gd challenge_events) that match 'filter'. 'sum' adds a field instead of counting. cat: shared (XP split across styles) or a style. Rewards: 'title:X', 'banner:X'.
